speaker: Head Coach
quote_text:
Hi everyone, have a question, raise your hand and  we'll come to you. Who's kicking off? Sam from  
Telegraph. Hi. Yeah, disappointed with the results  and with the performance as well. I think we never  
got the consistency in many areas to completely  dominate the game. We always had the feeling that,  
yeah, we had the ball, we had possession when  in front twice, but the game wasn't grabbed. It  
wasn't dominated and controlled in the way that we  normally do, because we were below the standards  
in some areas. And yeah, when you are not at your  best, but you are two times ahead, you have to be  
able to see the game off. And we weren't able  to do it, especially with what happened in the  
second goal. That PSG game is obviously just  looming. Do you think that was in the minds  
of the players? I know you wouldn't want it to  be, but do you think it was? Hopefully not, but  
we discussed that before and it wasn't there, and  today we had still six days to prepare that match,  
and I don't want you to use that. Obviously, we  have missed a lot of players, a lot of players  
that haven't trained at all, they weren't able to  do today, so we've been very short. But as well,  
credit to Palace, they are very well organised,  they are a really good side and they made it  
difficult for us and the reality as well,  that they were at our best. Alex Peppi. Hi,  
that's a 13th draw in the league. I know you've  missed a lot of key players and had some difficult  
circumstances, but is there a particular reason  do you think we've had so many draws this season?  
Well, let's say we haven't been able to see the  games off for many reasons and the margins have  
been too small. Sometimes that's something to the  position. It's true that we play five times with  
10 men. There are a lot of factors, but obviously  it's something that we've done much better in  
the past, especially when we've been ahead in  games and today without really much happening,  
especially in the second-half, we have to be  able to see the game off. Jordan, I just wonder  
what your thoughts were on the Martinelli got it  just loud and offside on side, whether the ball  
was off or not. Did you get a good view of it?  Did you think it was? No, it took a long time,  
but I haven't seen the replay yet, so I don't know  exactly what the decision, why the decision was.  
I don't know. And just in terms of the draws, is  it a valuable lesson in terms of the next season,  
if you're going for a title and you just can't  draw as many games as? Yeah, or lose. I mean,  
you have to win a certain amount of money and of  games and and some amount of points. We have only  
lost three games, two of them with 10 men, so I  would have to win minimal. Amy, sorry to mention  
this, Mikel, but like having spent so much of the  season looking at Liverpool and who's in front,  
are you now a little bit concerned about maybe  what's behind and and trying to stay in second,  
because you know, difficult period of the season  with. . . and the remaining games to play, and  
there are other teams on the hunt. We always look  because we know how tough it is to win football  
matches in the Premier League, and especially with  the amount of numbers and the amount of games that  
we have, we're going to have to be really good in  both competition to earn the right to be where we  
want to end up. Does finishing second mean a  lot to you? Sorry? Does finishing second mean  
a lot? We'll see where we finish. We have to  do everything that we can, game by game. Simon  
Collings. Mikel, what was the issue with. . .  Mikelen and Ben, are you hopeful that they'll  
be all right for Tuesday? Yeah, we have to wait  and see, but they weren't able to be in the squad  
today. Can I ask you as well about Leo? Obviously,  he didn't start either of those legs against Real  
Madrid, but he's responded, he's got four goals  in his last four games. How impressed have you  
been with that reaction and how much has he now  pushing to start? Very good. I think he's been a  
very consistent player for us, whether playing as  a nine, as a winger, starting or being a sub, and  
that's what he wants from play. He's always ready,  he's always fit, and he can make the difference in  
the moment. That's the best thing about Leo. OK,  I think we have the last couple. Firstly, Tom,  
these two games of Ipswich and now this game. Do  you feel like you've got a good idea in your mind  
about how you might set up for that game next week  with those two experiences? Without understanding  
who is available at the moment, very difficult.  OK, by James CBS. Hi, there's some fresh reports  
just before this game around Thomas Partey's  future in his contract. Is there any update  
in that, and do you want him to stay? I already  gave the update the other day, and I think it's  
not for me to give any more information about  that. OK, guys. Thanks very much. Thank you.
title: Mikel Arteta post-match press conference | Arsenal 2-2 Crystal Palace
